nusmp.skill.hercules.description: The Lord of Martial Prowess. Four passives (Adamantine Body, God of Strength, Unstoppable Momentum, Colossal Vigor), five feats of arms (Earth-Shattering Tremor, Invictus, Titan's Grip, Devastating Throw, Battle Roar) and, once mastered, World-Breaking Strike: one punch that shatters the barriers of the world, breaks armour and lays a heavy Temporal Debt on what it hits.
nusmp.skill.hercules.mastered: Hercules is mastered: World-Breaking Strike answers you, every feat costs less and cools down faster, and your blows, your regeneration and your momentum grow stronger.
